facts: Ariel Residences is an off-plan gated scheme of 14 detached two-storey villas in Kapparis, in the Protaras area of Famagusta district, near Ayia Triada beach.

The villas have three bedrooms upstairs with an en-suite master bedroom; the Type B design is also offered with a four-bedroom layout (fourth bedroom on the ground floor), and villa H12 is listed with four bedrooms.
Per the plans, Type A villas have 138.6 m² internal area (62 + 76.6 m²) plus a 14 m² covered veranda, and Type B villas 149.8 m² (70.8 + 79 m²) plus a 21 m² covered veranda.
Plots across the scheme range from 289 m² to 452 m²; the villas currently offered sit on plots of 306-413 m².
Each villa has a private 8 x 3 m skimmer pool, 1.40 m deep, with glass mosaic finish, in a walled garden with terrace.

The developer states Ayia Triada beach is about 500-520 m away, Malama beach 800 m, supermarkets 100 m, restaurants and shops 500 m, Paralimni Marina 2 km, a private hospital 4.6 km and Larnaca airport 45 km.
Kitchens have porcelain-slab worktops and backsplash with soft-close laminate units; bathrooms have wall-hung WCs and walk-in showers with channel drains.
Specification includes a photovoltaic system, EV-charging provision, CAT6 cabling, air-conditioning provision in all rooms and an A energy performance certificate.

conflicts: H12 bedrooms: the current 'TYPE B MIRROR PLANS (VILLAS H12,H13,H14)' drawing (dated February 2026) shows 3 bedrooms, all upstairs. The separate file 'ARIEL H12 TYPE B 4 BED.pdf' (older, dated OCT 2023, titled 'HOUSE TYPE B', not mirror) shows 4 bedrooms: bedroom 1 with shower room on the ground floor in place of the open-plan kitchen corner, and 3 bedrooms upstairs, same 70.8 + 79 = 149.8 m² and 21 m² veranda. The presentation p.18 labels this '4 BEDROOM OPTION UPON REQUEST'. So H12 = 4 bed (price list) is the optional layout on the same footprint; H02 (Type B1, plan dated Feb 2026) = 3 bed is the standard layout. Both are consistent with the plans; the website still shows H12 as 3 bedrooms.
Developer website lists H02 as RESERVED, while the price list offers it for sale (H05, H11, H12 match as Available).

Website states buildable area 166.60-191.80 m² and per-villa 166.25 m² (Type B) / 148.10 m² (Type A); the plans, leaflet, description and price list give internal areas of 138.6-149.8 m² (website figures appear to include verandas/other areas). Price list used.
Plot range: description and presentation say 297-384 m², website 297-452 m², the layout drawing 289-452 m², price list for the offered villas 306-413 m².
Distance to Ayia Triada beach: presentation 520 m, Google-location image 500 m, website 700 m.
Description docx and website text say 'near Ayia Triada Beach'; the website's location text block is copied from Olivia ('named for the enduring olive tree') and is not about Ariel.
Website text says '2 or 3 bedrooms upstairs'; all plans and the price list show 3 (or 4 with the option).
